title: taxi
summary: Benilla's flight-master wire: node-status query, taxi-map open (SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES with gate + nearest node + u32[8] known mask), the two flight verbs (single-hop ACTIVATETAXI when a direct TaxiPath edge exists, ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS with the node chain when not), SMSG_ACTIVATETAXIREPLY codes, and SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH on first contact. MSUI implements the status query, map open, mask decode, single-hop activate and reply/lockout handling, but not the express verb or the first-visit learn packet.

openItems.text: CMSG_ACTIVATETAXIEXPRESS never sent - MSUI always sends single-hop CMSG_ACTIVATETAXI from the current node, so a destination with no direct TaxiPath edge current->target (Benilla's byte-verified discriminator) cannot be flown
SMSG_NEW_TAXI_PATH has no handler - the never-visited-node first-contact learn pair is dropped on the floor

ApplyTaxiNodes rejects bodies under 20 bytes, so the gated-off 4-byte SMSG_SHOWTAXINODES form (leading gate word 0) throws instead of parsing to a no-op as Benilla does (never sent by vmangos, low impact)
